text:
alex: quick idea — we should make routing decisions a little more tier-aware. premium customers get strict latency-first selection, standard gets cost-aware with a latency cap, free gets opportunistic routing.

sana: +1. how do you see that working with model-variant fallbacks? e.g. switch to quantized variant if cross-region p95 spikes?

kevin: thinking: compute a region_score = w_latency * normalized_latency + w_cost * normalized_cost + w_slo_penalty. for premium w_slo_penalty is huge so latency wins. we can expose weights per customer via config.

jess: love score approach. need to be careful with cold-starts and cache locality — switching region can invalidate KV cache and blow latency. fallback rules should prefer same-region variant if possible.

maria: +1 on KV cache. proposal: allow a "soft affinity" tag -> prefer same-region model variant that is compatible (same vocab/kv-layout). only fall back to different region incompatible variants after X ms or N retries.

alex: proto config example:
```
routing_policy: 
  tiers: 
    premium: { weights: { latency: 0.8, cost: 0.1, sla: 0.1 }, max_latency_ms: 120 }
    standard: { weights: { latency: 0.5, cost: 0.4, sla: 0.1 }, max_latency_ms: 250 }
    free: { weights: { latency: 0.2, cost: 0.7, sla: 0.1 }, max_latency_ms: 400 }
  fallback: 
    try_same_region_variant_first: true
    cross_region_fallback_after_ms: 180
    degrade_to_quantized_after_ms: 120
```

kevin: runtime notes: we can compute normalized_latency from recent p50/p95 per region per route. cost = egress + infra_cost. need telemetry hooks to avoid oscillation — add hysteresis and cooldown windows.

jess: console UX ask: surface per-route heatmap: region distribution + fraction of requests hitting fallback variants + p50/p95 before/after fallback. make it easy to set per-route overrides.

maria: telemetry-wise we need labels: route_id, customer_tier, chosen_region, chosen_variant, kv_hit=true/false, latency_ms. that'll let us compute cache-loss delta when switching.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-v0.9 canary to 3% of traffic for 10m starting 1772457000.

alex: thanks — follow-ups: (1) kevin to sketch probe aggregator + score calc, (2) devex to mock console panel, (3) qa to design synthetic to validate cache impact. i'll open a RFC doc.

sana: can we add an escape hatch: customer override to pin to region or disable cross-region fallback? enterprise customers will want that for compliance.

alex: yes — add pin_region and opt_out_cross_region flags in the RFC.

kevin: I'll drop a rough impl PR tomorrow with config parsing + telemetry schema.

jess: small nit — for free tier maybe also enforce egress budget per day so routing prefers local until budget exhausted.

alex: good call. adding to RFC. :thumbsup:
